rows.label: tlk45200111_02_msg0001
rows.name:
The heart of the Driver decides
what Blade comes out of a Core
Crystal. Did you know that?!

rows.label: tlk45200111_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Weapons and elements change, of
course...

rows.label: tlk45200111_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Even the way they grow changes!
There are like, as many different
Blades as there are people!

rows.label: tlk45200111_02_msg0004
rows.name:
And if you keep resonating without
giving up, eventually you'll resonate
with an amazing Blade!
